message.content:
Here’s a mix‑and‑match lineup that covers classic chills, modern dread, supernatural scares, and mind‑bending terror—perfect for a Friday night marathon or a single binge session:

| # | Title & Year | Director | Runtime | Why It Works |
|---|---------------|----------|---------|--------------|
| **1** | *Hereditary* (2018) | Ari Aster | 127 min | Slow‑burn atmosphere + shocking twists make this one feel like a living nightmare. |
| **2** | *Get Out* (2017) | Jordan Peele | 104 min | Social satire meets genuine jump‑scares – clever, unsettling, and still fresh after all those years. |
| **3** | *A Quiet Place* (2018) | John Krasinski | 112 min | Silence as tension; minimal dialogue keeps you glued to the screen. |
| **4** | *It Follows* (2014) | David Robert Mitchell | 100 min | An everyday curse turned into relentless dread; perfect for late‑night paranoia. |
| **5** | *Midsommar* (2019) | Ari Aster | 147 min | Daylight horror flips expectations; the cult ritual scenes will haunt your dreams. |
| **6** | *The Conjuring* (2013) | James Wan | 112 min | Classic haunted house vibes with solid pacing and creepy set pieces. |
| **7** | *Suspiria* (1977) | Dario Argento | 107 min | If you’re craving old‑school giallo style, its color palette and score are unforgettable. |
| **8** | *Us* (2019) | Jordan Peele | 115 min | Mirror image horror that plays with identity and family dynamics. |
| **9** | *The Babadook* (2014) | Jennifer Kent | 94 min | Psychological depth plus a truly iconic monster design. |
| **10** | *Candyman* (1992) | Bernard Rose | 102 min | Urban legend reimagined with strong social commentary and chilling visuals. |

### How to Watch

| Movie | Streaming / Purchase Options (as of early 2026) |
|-------|---------------------------------------------|
| Hereditary | HBO Max (subscription), Vudu/Apple TV (rental/purchase) |
| Get Out | Peacock Premium, Amazon Video (rent/buy) |
| A Quiet Place | Paramount+ (free tier), iTunes/Amazon (buy/rent) |
| It Follows | Shudder (subscribed), Amazon Video (rent/buy) |
| Midsommar | Disney+, Amazon Video (rent/buy) |
| The Conjuring | Universal+ (included), Amazon Video (rent/buy) |
| Suspiria | Criterion Channel, Amazon Video (rent/buy) |
| Us | Peacock Premium, Apple TV (rent/buy) |
| The Babadook | Shudder, Amazon Video (rent/buy) |
| Candyman | HBO Max, Amazon Video (rent/buy) |

> **Tip:** Pair each film with a dark snack (think popcorn dusted with chili flakes or black chocolate) and dim lighting for maximum immersion!

Enjoy your fright-filled Friday! 🎃🖤
